title: Eleven Rules and One Man
subtitle: 领袖政治 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 领袖政治（历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）
meta: 主题语境：领袖政治（历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）　|　核心词汇：rule　|　正文 295 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rule 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: For thirty-one years our school was ① under the rule of one man, Mr Hall, who never raised his voice and never needed to. The ② rules he wrote were eleven, they fit on one side of paper, and they were the same in 1974 as in 2005. As a ③ rule he did not explain them, and the not explaining was, I now think, the whole of his method.

The first ④ rule was that nobody ran inside, and the last was that nobody was sent home without a note, and between them were nine others which I have forgotten. The one ⑤ rule all of us broke, every day for thirty-one years and with his knowledge, was the rule about the back gate, which was barred at four and which was never once locked.

He kept a wooden ⑥ rule on his desk, twelve inches long and unmarked by any number, and he never once used it for measuring, which everybody understood. The ⑦ golden rule, as he called it, was not on the list: it was that a rule you cannot explain is not a rule but a habit.

By ⑧ rule of thumb he gave a boy two warnings, and a third only once in thirty-one years. He said he had ⑨ broken that rule himself more than once, and knew it. When he retired in 2005 the new head wrote forty rules, printed them and put them on the wall, and within a year the school was noisier than it had been in thirty-one, and has been ever since.

Mr Hall died in 2011, and the school was pulled down in 2015. In his school, quiet was the ⑩ rule rather than the exception, and I have never been in another building like it, or met another man like him.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 规则；规章；规定
B. n. 统治；管辖（under the rule of ...）
C. n. 常规；惯例（the rule rather than the exception）
D. 固定搭配：as a rule 通常；一般来说
E. 固定搭配：rule of thumb 经验法则；粗略的做法
G. 固定搭配：break a / the rule 违反规则
H. 固定搭配：the golden rule 黄金准则；最重要的原则

items.q: our school was under the rule of one man
The rules he wrote were eleven
As a rule he did not explain them
The first rule was that nobody ran inside
The one rule all of us broke
He kept a wooden rule on his desk
The golden rule, as he called it
By rule of thumb he gave a boy two warnings
He said he had broken that rule himself
quiet was the rule rather than the exception

answers.why: under the rule of ... 意为“在……的统治／管辖之下”，学校三十一年都在一个人的管理之下。
rules 意为“规章、规定”，他写的规章共十一条。
as a rule 意为“通常、一般来说”，他一般不作解释。
rule 意为“规定”，第一条是室内不许奔跑。
break a rule 意为“违反规定”，我们天天违反的是后门那一条。
a rule 意为“尺子、直尺”，他桌上那把木尺十二英寸长，上面没有刻度。
the golden rule 意为“黄金准则、最重要的原则”，他说解释不了的规定不是规定而是习惯。
rule of thumb 意为“经验法则、凭经验的做法”，他凭经验给一个孩子两次警告。
break the rule 意为“违反规则”，他自己也犯过不止一次，而且知道。
the rule rather than the exception 意为“是常规而不是例外”，安静在他的学校里是常态。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们学校在一个人的管理之下度过了三十一年。（under the rule of）
他写的规章只有十一条。（rules）
他通常不作解释。（as a rule）
第一条规章是不许在室内奔跑。（rule）
我们天天违反的是关于后门的那一条。（break a rule）
凭经验，他给一个孩子两次警告。（rule of thumb）
answers: Our school was under the rule of one man for thirty-one years.
The rules he wrote were eleven.
As a rule he did not explain them.
The first rule was that nobody ran inside.
The one rule all of us broke was the rule about the back gate.
By rule of thumb he gave a boy two warnings.
